data.narrative:
Skild AI, founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, is a Series C-stage AI & Software company valued at $14.0B post-money following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe comprises nine comparable companies across AI and software infrastructure, including five private peers (Figure AI, Crusoe Energy, Wayve, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs) and one public reference (Palantir, PLTR).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yields $23.8B from the $14.0B base. Peer-median valuation across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies produces $8.6B, with the peer sample ranging from $3.2B (Black Forest Labs, Series B) to $39.0B (Figure AI, Series C).

The triangulated range spans $7.3B to $27.4B, with a median of $16.2B. This wide spread reflects material variance within the peer set, particularly the $39.0B outlier valuation of Figure AI relative to other Series C and Series D stage companies. Skild AI's current $14.0B post-money sits near the lower end of the implied range, suggesting modest upside under stage-progression assumptions but sits above peer medians. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-step multiplier given frontier AI market dynamics and whether Figure AI's valuation represents sustainable market pricing or a sector-specific premium.
